Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
Ok, these Q's may already be answered before.

1) Can a Mind Rape target an already tapped vampire? I'd say so but card
text explicitely says so.

2) Can a ready malkavian take a Madness network action at the end of my
predators turn to mind rape a younger vampire contolled by my prey,
tapping it, and taking control of it in my next minion phase?
(That "does not untap effect" makes me wonder)

I do believe that the answer to both q's must be "yes" but just want to
make sure.

Tim

Mind Rape [SAB] - Action (dom) (2)

New card text for superior: "(D) put this card on a younger
vampire and tap that vampire. The vampire with this card does not untap
as normal during his controller's untap phase. During the acting
vampire's controller's next minion phase, she must burn this card to
untap the vampire and take control of the vampire until the end of her
turn." [RTR 19980707]

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tim Eijpe wrote:
> 1) Can a Mind Rape target an already tapped vampire? I'd say so but card
> text explicitely says so.

Yes, so long as he is younger than the acting vampire.

> 2) Can a ready malkavian take a Madness network action at the end of my
> predators turn to mind rape a younger vampire contolled by my prey,
> tapping it, and taking control of it in my next minion phase?
> (That "does not untap effect" makes me wonder)

He can take a Madness Network action during your predator's minion phase
(after your predator has finished all of her actions) to play Mind Rape
as you describe, yes. If you are the controller of that Malkavian, then
you'll burn Mind Rape and take control of the target vampire during your
imminent "next" minion phase, yes.

> I do believe that the answer to both q's must be "yes" but just want to
> make sure.
>

> untap the vampire and take control of the vampire until the end of her
> turn." [RTR 19980707]
